title: Conditional κ = 0.001676070884699375: exact helper-donor cold kernel for pivot 531 on the global mixed X54 fusions word
body:
## Summary

Conditional κ = **0.001676070884699375**. Replaces the three early gates of the pivot-531 cold kernel (output-target donors 115/179 and partner 507) with an exact helper-donor kernel (donors 636 and 351 at frame [30]), found by an exact backward output-sensitivity relation search and kept legal by the unchanged k8 frame model, with one exact tail-gate endpoint correction (351 += 531) in the refactored cleanup. Local paid profile changes by H1 -3, H3 +1 per call in both providers (widths, ports, centres, owners and dispatch unchanged). Both provider words pass fresh native replay; the plan/SPEC are re-bound and re-frozen through the unchanged discovery path, and strict admission gives kappa 0.001676070884699375 (+2.612e-7 over PR1218).
